data.name: Castleborne Survivors
data.detailed_description:
The castle has been swallowed by darkness, and monsters are pouring in from every direction. Fight your way through the horde and survive until the end!

A survivors-like game, now with side-scrolling action combat.

Castleborne Survivors blends roguelite progression with Metroidvania-inspired elements. Upgrade, enhance, merge, and enchant your way to greater power, until even overwhelming waves of monsters are no longer something to fear.

This is no longer a top-down survivors experience. Move, reposition, and dodge your way through the swarm — or build a weapon setup so powerful that enemies are wiped out before they can even reach you.

Gather coins in each run to buy permanent upgrades and push deeper into the castle on your next attempt.

Synthesize Your Weapons

Synthesize your weapons with passives to create even more powerful weapons!

Enchant Your Signature Weapon

Enchant your character’s signature weapon to give it even more powerful effects!

Two-Player Co-op

Supports local two-player co-op on the same screen. Online co-op is currently in development.

data.short_description: A survivors-like game with side-scrolling action combat. Slash, dodge, and mow down endless monsters in a gothic horror castle. Upgrade with every choice, snowball out of control, and survive until the very end.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or better, DirectX 12 feature level 12_0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better, DirectX 12 feature level 12_0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
